title: 第一卷 第21章 难不成那位梦里的老神仙又赏赐你了第一卷 第22章 这要是真的老夫现场把这桌子腿儿给啃了
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 宁天神清气爽地从自己的寝殿走出来。
昨晚大半宿的操劳，通过今天的早操，全被纯阳白虎功化解得一干二净。
他现在非但没觉得虚，反而浑身上下有使不完的劲。
伸了个大大的懒腰，宁天溜溜达达地顺着长廊，朝宗主议事大厅走去。
拿到这么丰厚的奖励，自然得拿去给自家人开开眼，这才是正经事。
刚走到大厅门口，就听见里面传出古榕那极具辨识度的嗓门。
“风致啊，你是没看见，昨天玉元震那老皮夫被老剑骨头一剑劈进坑里的时候，那张脸比锅底还黑！”
“我听手底下人说，他们回去之后，蓝电霸王龙宗大门一关，连山都不下了！”
大厅里。
宁风致端坐在主位上，尘心和古榕分坐两旁。
尘心连眼皮都没抬。
“他自己找上门来讨打，怪得了谁。
这头老龙要是再敢来，恐怕就不是狼狈收场了。”
宁风致放下手里的茶盏，轻轻叹了口气。
“对现在的七宝琉璃宗而言，蓝电霸王龙宗不足为惧。”
“可上三宗同气连枝，自然不要轻易留下芥蒂，我想，玉宗主也明白这一点。”
“要担心的，是武魂殿那边。”
宁风致屈起手指叩了叩桌面。
“萨拉斯那老狐狸，昨天看完戏，直接带人连夜出了天斗城，直奔武魂圣城去了。”
古榕撇了撇嘴。
“去就去呗，武魂殿还能为了这点事，直接跟搞事不成？”
“不可不防。”
宁风致面色严肃。
“咱们昨天露出的底牌太吓人，我估计比比东，千道流，有可能会搞动作，到时候，怕是有些麻烦。”
正说着，大厅的厚重木门被一把推开。
“麻烦？怕什么麻烦？”
宁天大摇大摆地跨进门槛，顺手拉过一把椅子，直接瘫了上去，还不忘翘起二郎腿。
“爹，咱们七宝琉璃宗现在兵强马壮，他们武魂殿要是不服气，大不了碰一碰。”
看到宁天这副没正形的模样，屋里的气氛瞬间松快了不少。
古榕两步跨过去，围着宁天转了一圈，上下打量，一张老脸上的表情别提多猥琐了。
“呦，咱们的新郎官起这么早？”
“老头子我以为，你今天得睡到日上三竿呢！”
古榕伸出大手，重重拍在宁天的肩膀上，嘿嘿直乐。
“天儿啊，是不是你这小身板不行啊？”
“我估摸着水家那丫头可是冰属性的武魂，寒气重。
昨晚大婚之夜，没给你冻坏吧？”
“要不骨爷爷去药房给你抓两副大补的方子，鹿茸人参多熬点？”
宁天翻了个白眼，一把推开古榕的手。
“骨爷爷，您这也太瞧不起人了。”
“我身体好得很，火力旺着呢。”
他顺手端起桌上的茶壶，给自己倒了一杯水，一饮而尽。
content_en:
Ning Tian walked out of his bedroom refreshed.
Most of last night's hard work, through today's morning exercises, was completely resolved by the Pure Yang White Tiger Kung Fu.
Not only did he not feel weak now, but he felt endless energy all over his body.
Stretching out greatly, Ning Tian strolled along the long corridor towards the sect leader's meeting hall.
After receiving such a generous reward, I naturally have to use it to open the eyes of my family. This is a serious matter.
As soon as I walked to the door of the hall, I heard Gu Rong's highly recognizable voice coming from inside.
"Fengzhi, you didn't see that when Yu Yuanzhen, the old man, was slashed into the pit by the old sword bone yesterday, his face was darker than the bottom of the pot!"
"I heard from my subordinates that after they returned, once the gate of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Sect was closed, they couldn't even get down the mountain!"
in the hall.
Ning Fengzhi sat on the main seat, Chen Xin and Gu Rong sat on both sides.
Chen Xin didn't even raise his eyelids.
“He came to the door to ask for a beating, who can blame him.
If this old dragon dares to come again, I'm afraid it won't end in embarrassment. "
Ning Fengzhi put down the tea cup in his hand and sighed softly.
"For the current Qibao Glazed Sect, the Blue Lightning Overlord Dragon Sect is not something to be afraid of."
"But the three sects are connected by the same spirit, so naturally we shouldn't leave grudges easily. I think Master Jade also understands this."
"What we have to worry about is the side of Wuhun Palace."
Ning Fengzhi raised her fingers and tapped the table.
"That old fox Saras, after watching the show yesterday, he took his people out of Tiandou City overnight and went straight to the Holy City of Martial Spirits."
Gu Rong pouted.
"Just go, can Wuhun Palace still cause trouble directly for this matter?"
"You must be on guard."
Ning Fengzhi looked serious.
"The trump card we revealed yesterday was too scary. I guess Bibi Dong and Qian Daoliu may make some moves. Then I'm afraid there will be some trouble."
Just as he was talking, the heavy wooden door of the hall was pushed open.
"Trouble? What trouble are you afraid of?"
Ning Tian swaggered across the threshold, pulled out a chair, and slumped down on it, not forgetting to cross his legs.
"Dad, our Qibao Glazed Sect is now very strong. If their Wuhun Palace is not convinced, the worst is to give them a try."
Seeing Ning Tian's unformed appearance, the atmosphere in the room instantly relaxed a lot.
Gu Rong stepped over in two steps and circled around Ning Tian, ​​looking up and down. The expression on his old face was extremely vulgar.
"Hey, does our groom get up so early?"
"Old man, I thought you had to sleep until midnight today!"
Gu Rong stretched out his big hand and patted Ning Tian's shoulder hard, feeling happy.
"My God, is it because your small body can't handle it?"
"I guess that girl from the Shui family has an ice-attribute martial spirit and is very cold.
Didn't you freeze on the wedding night last night? "
"Why don't Grandpa Gu go to the pharmacy and get you two big tonic prescriptions, some more deer antler and ginseng?"
Ning Tian rolled his eyes and pushed Gu Rong's hand away.
"Grandpa Bone, you are so disrespectful."
"I'm in good health and have a lot of energy."
He picked up the teapot on the table, poured himself a glass of water, and drank it in one gulp.
